description: The configurations of one product with their launch prices, to answer '$399 for which one?': storage, size, colour and material, each with its source; the retailer listings that are this exact model; and the conditions retailers attach to a member price, coupon, bundle, refurbished or trade-in offer, for the retailers where iDevice has read a price for it. Pass retailer (for example 'Best Buy') to see one store's conditions, with or without a product.

retailer.description: A store name, e.g. 'Best Buy', 'Costco', 'Verizon'. Adds that store's offer conditions.

name: get_variants_and_offers
title: Configurations, listings and offer conditions
